decisions.decision: Build the page model on the host and ship it in the initial nav state
decisions.why: A report panel re-renders its whole HTML on every switch and file change, so the model is always current and stories can call the same pure builders
decisions.rejected: Parsing in the webview, which only receives one document

decisions.why: The reading column and the outline are keyed to that element
decisions.rejected: A sibling pane like the Overview, which gets no outline

decisions.decision: Story is a first, file-less document entry on a bug; an idea Decision stage renders the decision page
decisions.why: The rail and switchDocument already handle document entries and the read-only allow-list permits it
decisions.rejected: A client-side tab toggle, lost on every reload

decisions.decision: Six bug leads derived from bugState plus the test report
decisions.why: bugState folds four situations into to-fix and must not change
decisions.rejected: Extending BugState, which drives pane grouping and footer buttons

decisions.decision: A small fragment renderer instead of renderMarkdown per section
decisions.why: renderMarkdown adds heading ids and comment controls

decisions.decision: New lists IDEA_RATINGS and BUG_CHECK_RESULTS; allow-lists move to fs-free modules
decisions.why: Every state-like value must be recognised, and Storybook cannot import fs

decisions.decision: Once a bug is tested, list only the test report residual risks
decisions.why: The three reports restate the same risks in different words, which read as repetition
decisions.rejected: Merging assessment risks, open questions and residual risks

decisions.why: Existing tests list the bug-reports and idea-reports folders by name
decisions.rejected: Adding them beside the existing fixtures and rewriting 14 tests

decisions.decision: A panel sent off Story because it could not be built returns to it on the next refresh
decisions.why: Assess again rewriting the file mid-read knocked the reader onto the raw report for good
decisions.rejected: Leaving the reader on the fallback

decisions.decision: Pass and fail check results carry a tone
decisions.why: A failed check read the same as a passed one

plan.summary: Pure parse and model layer on the host, page rendered by Preact inside the content element, Story as a document entry, one new CSS partial
plan.key_finding: Report panels reload their whole HTML on every tab switch, so the model must ride in the initial nav state and Story must be a host-side document type

approach: Pure builders in features/reports turn report text into a BugStory or IdeaDecision. readReportPanel calls them and the model travels as NavState.report. The webview renders it inside #markdown-content with rp- classes from one new partial, and Storybook builds the same pages from fixtures.
